decisions.reason: The construction site dumper was only mentioned on the website and there is no evidence from 2020 or 2021, so its value is still uncertain, but keeping it in a vehicle-building firm costs little and preserves the option to build on it.
The inclined furniture lift had its own page and fits the firm's lifting and material-handling know-how, so the option is cheap to hold and no results yet show it has failed.
The inclined building material lift has its own page and is a low-cost, related variant that serves construction customers, so it is worth keeping open while demand becomes clearer.

The truck-mounted furniture lift is a more specialized variant with somewhat higher carrying costs, but it shares technology with the other lifts and there is no evidence yet that would justify dropping it.
